author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
description:
From malaria to tuberculosis, infectious diseases still kill millions every year. For survivors, it’s not just a health battle, it also drains time and money, often trapping people in poverty. By lowering treatment costs and enabling people to live healthy lives, every dollar invested not only saves lives but also boosts economies so places once held back by disease can thrive.
